doc.title: Steve Gilmore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Delaware Water Gap, PA, November 8, 1999

title: Closing advice and thanks
summary: He advises saving money and thinking of the future, and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: That’s the life, yeah. And I’m glad I have it. I’m happy to be doing what I’m doing. I wish I was doing more of it, but I’m very happy to be doing what I’m doing. I would never discourage anybody from a life of music. It’s beautiful. You just have to keep your head together and kind of think — I made a lot of mistakes and I didn’t think for the future when I was younger and I should have. Make sure you have enough sense to put away that fifty or hundred bucks a week and save for a rainy day. And don’t think that the work is always going to be there because it’s always not going to be you have to save. And anybody listening in or watching this particular event, you always have to think
about that, think about the future and don’t let it ever discourage you from playing music because it’s a wonderful life.
All right. Well said. Thanks a lot.
Okay, thank you, Monk, what time is it? I did talk, didn’t I? Big mouth.
